pages.title: Method
pages.content:
( 02 ) Method

Five phases, so the weekend holds.

Week −6 · Survey

A free walk-through of both floors with Samir Haddad: measurements, doorway widths and photographs of every room.

Week −3 · Plan & label

A labelled floor plan gives each team one colour zone and each desk one number. Every crate and cable bag gets its matching destination tag.

10 working days before · Pack

Reusable crates arrive at your office. Staff pack their own desk, about six crates each, with three weeks of rental included.

The weekend · 61 hours

Friday 18:00 lift and load. Saturday 07:00 the old floor is empty. Desks and IT are back by Sunday 12:00; the keys return on Monday 07:00.

Monday · 07:00–12:00

Two crew members stay on site all morning for small fixes. The crates are collected within three weeks.

pages.title: Moves
pages.content:
( 04 ) Moves

Three moves, told plainly.

Forty-two desks, two floors down

Ghent · 42 desks · Fri 18:00 → Sun 16:40. An architecture studio merged two floors into one; all forty-two desks were powered, aligned and clean more than fourteen hours before opening.

The law office that never closed

Brussels · 26 desks. Sealed archive crates with tamper tags moved down a quiet corridor, with the reception desk working again on Monday morning.

Benches, a rack and a cold room

Mechelen · 64 desks. A padded equipment case and a server rack wheeled between laboratory benches, reconnected by Joanna Kowalczyk and her IT crew.

pages.title: Request a quote
pages.content:
( 08 ) Request a quote

Tell us three things.

Your desk count and office size

Mei Lin Hartmann calls within one working day to go through your schedule and book a free survey with Samir Haddad.

Your current and new addresses

We cover Antwerp, Ghent, Brussels, Mechelen, Leuven and Rotterdam, within 150 km of Dokweg 12, 2030 Antwerp.

The weekend you have in mind

Phone: +32 3 555 01 41. Email: hello@issorelocation.example. Office hours: Mon–Fri 08:30–17:30.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content:
Privacy

Privacy Policy

What we collect

When you ask for a quote we keep your name, company, email, phone number, addresses and desk count, only to prepare your survey and quote.

How long and who sees it

Quote requests are kept for 12 months, are read only by our planning team, and are never sold or shared for advertising. Write to hello@issorelocation.example to see or delete your data.
